title: The Prompt Makes the Person(a): A Systematic Evaluation of Sociodemographic Persona Prompting for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating diverse racial and ethnic personas (Asian, Black, Hispanic, Middle-Eastern, White) using different prompting strategies (explicit, structured, name-based) and evaluating the outputs via marked word counts, semantic diversity of sentence embeddings, language switching detection (e.g., for the 'perpetual foreigner' stereotype), and alignment with human survey distributions.

Simulating male, female, and nonbinary personas using various prompting strategies and evaluating the generated self-descriptions, social media bios, and survey responses for stereotyping (using marked word counts), semantic homogenization (semantic diversity), and alignment with human opinion distributions.
